title: VerifierLabel
description: One labeled finding for verifier calibration (spec §6.8, PRD FR-X9): a PR, a candidate finding on it, and whether the finding is true or wrong. The verifier must refute at least 90% of known-wrong findings and at most 10% of known-true ones (global.yaml eval_thresholds.verifier). Labels from author feedback live in the verifier_labels table; these files are the seed set.

label.description: true: the finding is correct; wrong: it is not.

rule.description: The rule the finding is for; its severity and category frame the claim.

claim.description: The finding's message, as the generator wrote it.
